label: Recipe Book
notes: status_route is null: this rail renders no model chips. It has the most model slots of any rail and no way to see any of their states, which is a gap rather than a design choice — see docs/RAIL_CONTRACT.md.

Its GET /api/models is NOT a chip endpoint. It is a passthrough of the broker's installed-model inventory, and predates the chip contract. The name collides with the chip route on co-worker and terminal-fun; do not confuse the two payloads.

Holds the one sanctioned exception to the @role rule: RECIPE_BOOK_LLM_MODEL in broker.py is a module-level fallback with no role of its own. It is not a manifest slot because nothing configures it per-deployment.
